description: Source code implementing command-line interface functions for managing Git references, reflogs, and ref stores, including functions for creating, deleting, renaming, resolving, verifying, and iterating over refs and reflogs.

methods.name: parse_flags
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of flag names into a bitmask based on provided flag definitions.

methods.name: get_store
methods.description: Determines the appropriate ref store based on command-line arguments, supporting main, submodule, and worktree backends.

methods.name: cmd_create_symref
methods.description: Creates a symbolic reference in the specified ref store.

methods.name: cmd_delete_refs
methods.description: Deletes multiple references with specified flags and message.

methods.name: cmd_rename_ref
methods.description: Renames a reference from old to new name with optional log message.

methods.name: each_ref
methods.description: Callback function to print reference details.

methods.name: cmd_for_each_ref
methods.description: Iterates over references matching a prefix.

methods.name: cmd_for_each_ref__exclude
methods.description: Iterates over references matching a prefix, excluding specified patterns.

methods.name: cmd_resolve_ref
methods.description: Resolves a reference to its object ID and flags.

methods.name: cmd_verify_ref
methods.description: Verifies if a reference name is available.

methods.name: each_reflog
methods.description: Callback to print reflog names.

methods.name: cmd_for_each_reflog
methods.description: Iterates over reflog entries.

methods.name: each_reflog_ent
methods.description: Callback to print reflog entry details.

methods.name: cmd_for_each_reflog_ent
methods.description: Iterates over reflog entries for a specific ref.

methods.name: cmd_for_each_reflog_ent_reverse
methods.description: Iterates over reflog entries in reverse order.

methods.name: cmd_reflog_exists
methods.description: Checks if a reflog exists for a reference.

methods.name: cmd_create_reflog
methods.description: Creates a reflog for a reference.

methods.name: cmd_delete_reflog
methods.description: Deletes a reflog for a reference.

methods.name: cmd_delete_ref
methods.description: Deletes a reference with a message, old object ID, and flags.

methods.name: cmd_update_ref
methods.description: Updates a reference to a new object ID with optional old ID and flags.

methods.name: cmd__ref_store
methods.description: Main command handler for ref store operations, dispatching to specific subcommands.
